professionalSummary.text: Technical lead of a real-time card authorisation service at a retail bank since 2022, with eight years of cumulative software engineering experience in the service (2017-2022 as software/senior software engineer, 2022-present as lead engineer).
professionalSummary.witness: Lead Engineer and technical lead of the card authorisation service at a retail bank since 2022, signing the design reviews for changes to the authorisation path; software engineer and senior software engineer on the same service from 2017 to 2022; eight years of software engineering in all.

professionalSummary.text: Holds the bank's secure development certification for the payments domain, valid since 2021 with renewal in 2024, documented in the bank's learning record.
professionalSummary.witness: Secure development certification for the payments domain held since 2021 under the bank's secure development programme, renewed 2024; certificate available in the bank's learning record.

experienceHighlights.text: Signed design reviews for changes to the authorisation path as technical lead since 2022, with boundary notes documenting scope limitations for each review.
experienceHighlights.witness: Lead Engineer and technical lead of the card authorisation service at a retail bank since 2022, signing the design reviews for changes to the authorisation path; ... Mentored the team's six engineers under the engineering mentoring scheme and wrote the boundary note of each signed design review, stating what the review did not cover.

experienceHighlights.text: Led incident reviews for four authorisation outages over the last three years under the documented payments incident review process, with reports stored in the incident register.

experienceHighlights.text: Owner of the service's technical roadmap since 2022, reviewed quarterly with the head of payments engineering.
